_meta.lens_grammar: Each lens is [expr, sign]; sign +1 higher-is-better, -1 lower-is-better. expr is a validated column or an arithmetic expression over validated columns with + - * / and helpers: pos(x)=x.where(x>0) (a negative multiple is not cheap); abs(x); nz(x)=x.fillna(0) (only for analyst counts, where compute() treats missing coverage as zero); days_since(date_col)=days from the date to today. (normalized_ebitda/normalized_revenue*revenue_ttm) is the margin-based mid-cycle EBITDA compute() already uses.
_meta.scoring: Same rule as _spirit() in archetype_tags.py: rank each lens*sign within the archetype's current members (pct), require >= 5 non-null members per lens and >= ceil(n_lenses/2) lenses per name, spirit = mean of available lens ranks. When 'blend' is set, spirit = w0*spirit(groupA) + w1*spirit(groupB); group entries are lens exprs whose signs come from 'lenses'.
_meta.validation: Every identifier was checked against the headers of archetype_tags.csv, asymmetry_global.csv, the compute() overlays (ts_, tc_, fqx_, fq_, fmp_st_, fmp_seg/geo, bs_, sent_, evt_ renamed from ev_, fmp_enrichment, fmp_dynamics, fmp_institutional, EDGAR side files) or a df[...] assignment / _fmp_fill in archetype_tags.py; every expression was evaluated on the frame compute() builds (46,526 rows; compute() re-run 2026-09-26 ~15:50 UTC on a scratch copy of the current archetype_tags.py and live CSVs). _validation holds n_core, the share of current members for which the spirit can be computed, per-lens coverage, the largest pairwise Spearman correlation between lens ranks, and each lens's Spearman correlation with the resulting spirit.

asymmetric_assembly.note: PSIX conjunction, one lens per engine: bad headline/better economics (GP outgrowing revenue), EBITDA rising, stub torque, cheapness on cash, low expectations.
asymmetric_assembly.source: COMP III Assembly theory "requires a minimum set of correctly-combined value components"; CODE PSIX "gross profit +10% on revenue -18%".

bab_becoming.note: Becoming BAB-like: measured beta compression plus the fundamental de-risking behind it (margins, cash margin, net debt falling).
bab_becoming.source: CODE "Becoming more BAB-like ... improving fundamental stability stands in for the paper's beta compression" - ts_dbeta_3y now measures it directly.

bab_low_beta.note: Existing bab_score (low shrunk beta + quality + cheap) corroborated by independently measured weekly 3y beta and downside capture.
bab_low_beta.source: CODE Frazzini & Pedersen (2014): "long safe, profitable, low-beta assets".

bab_multibagger.note: Boring safety + embedded compounding: bab_score, measured beta, FCF yield and the Yartseva multibagger score.
bab_multibagger.source: MAR II "Yartseva's single most important driver: FCF/P"; CODE BAB synthesis.

balance_sheet_return.note: Cash-rich runoff: how much of the price the balance sheet covers and how fast it is being handed back.
balance_sheet_return.source: COMP II.A "Liquidations / wind-downs ... serial liquidating distributions"; WO Archetype 4 "Share buybacks below NAV".

base_ignition.note: Coil quality plus ignition strength: dollar-volume expansion, up/down volume, right-side relative strength.
base_ignition.source: COMP II.B Andreola footprint "1-2 quarters before the run ... while institutional ownership and coverage are still near zero"; MAR VI "52-week high or base breakout".

biotech_deep_value.note: Existing biotech_deep_value_score is the right measure (paid to own the cash, free pipeline option); corroborated by NCAV cover and runway.
biotech_deep_value.source: MAR I.F (12) "Option Mispriced as Dead ... balance sheet survives to catalyst"; PER QSI failure "near cash value but burning ~$120m annually" -> runway matters.

book_compounder_discount.note: Audited book compounding (5y BVPS CAGR, ROE) priced below book and tangible book.
book_compounder_discount.source: COMP I.4 Tillinghast "ROE >10-12% sustained ~10 years"; CODE F14 "BV growth is the hardest series to fake".

bottleneck.note: Economic footprint of a chokepoint: durable (worst-year) and current gross margin, toll-road returns, capital-light, margin not eroding.
bottleneck.source: MAR I.B "The Constraint - owns a bottleneck. A large system cannot scale without the small component"; MAR VII Akre "bottleneck asset ... unit-economics machine".

buyback_compounder.note: Cannibalisation over 5y and 3y plus the current pace, on a durable-ROIC base, with FCF per share (the accretion) rising now and over 5y.
buyback_compounder.source: COMP II.B "Share count - Flat or shrinking ... The cardinal sin. Dilution (losers diluted ~61%, winners ~22%)"; COMP II.D "share-count reduction".

cannibal_at_discount.note: Retiring stock below book: current and 3y shrink (longer cannibalisation is better), buyback pace and depth below book (accretion per share).
cannibal_at_discount.source: COMP II.D "insider buying; share-count reduction"; WO Archetype 4 "Share buybacks below NAV".

capex_famine_harvest.note: Investment cycle ending: capex vs its own 5y average (two sources) and vs D&A, with the FCF inflection loaded and the price at/below book.
capex_famine_harvest.source: COMP II.D Capital cycle "Capex cuts ... falling capex/depreciation ratios ... low returns repel capital -> capacity withdrawal -> rising returns".

capital_discipline.note: Allocation discipline read through returns on capital (accrual and cash), a shrinking share count, cash actually returned and owner alignment.
capital_discipline.source: MAR I.E (10) "Capital Discipline / Governance Re-rating" (Korea Value-Up, TSE PBR reform); COMP II.D buy-side signals "management focused on returns/discipline ... share-count reduction".

capital_light_pivot.note: The asset-light transition: revenue outgrowing the asset base, ROIC turning up, low capex needs and a rising gross margin.
capital_light_pivot.source: MAR I.A "The Reclassified Thing ... The multiple changes when the noun changes" (DFIN printer->SaaS); PER DFIN "transitioning toward higher-value SaaS".

cash_adjusted_pe.note: Ex-cash P/E (p_e x (1 - net cash/mcap), currency-neutral), net-cash share of price and cash corroboration of the earnings.
cash_adjusted_pe.source: CODE F4 "NEGATIVE is only CHEAP when the earnings are POSITIVE ... the whole operating business comes free plus change".

cash_quality.note: Earnings hide the cash: cash-over-NOPAT ROIC gap, CFO/NI on two independent sources, low accruals, and FCF persistence over the full history.
cash_quality.source: COMP I.4 Tillinghast red flags "receivables/inventory growing faster than sales"; MAR II Yartseva "FCF/P ... single most important driver".

cash_reinvest.note: Cash-confirmed reinvestment: incremental and base cash ROIC, through-cycle FCF margin and FCF persistence, how much capital is being deployed, and the result: 5y FCF-per-share compounding.
cash_reinvest.source: COMP I.1 (2)-(3) sustained ROIC + reinvestment runway; MAR II "Yartseva ... it is the LEVEL of profitability and cash flow, not the GROWTH RATE".

cheap_per_roiic.note: Price paid per unit of reinvestment yield (lower is better), corroborated by the ROIIC level on accrual and cash bases and by the cash yield.
cheap_per_roiic.source: COMP I.1 "(5) A low starting valuation" with (2)-(3) high ROIC + runway; "Twin engines of return = earnings growth x multiple expansion".

cheap_sales_scaler.note: Un-re-rated scaler: cheap vs growth and on sales, growth rate, and operating leverage showing.
cheap_sales_scaler.source: COMP II.B "Valuation - Room to expand (majority of winners <3x sales)"; "$5-10m revenue businesses that are slightly profitable that turn into $30-40m businesses".

cluseau_buyback_accel.note: Buybacks accelerating into a discount with cash deployed: pace, acceleration vs trend, net shrink, depth below book, cash-light.
cluseau_buyback_accel.source: CODE Cluseau "Georgia Capital pattern (3% -> 5% -> 7% of shares repurchased a year, cash run from 20% to 3%)". 12 members.

cluseau_realizable_book.note: Realizable-book discount that management is closing: depth below tangible book, cash share of that book, payout and share shrink.
cluseau_realizable_book.source: CODE Cluseau: "a sub-book multiple is worth something only when (a) the BOOK IS REALIZABLE ... (b) MANAGEMENT ACTUALLY RETURNS IT".

coiled_base.note: Existing coiled_base_score plus base duration (longer base better) and the coil on sales and EBIT (value accreted under a flat price).
coiled_base.source: MAR II Bessembinder "top 100 ... averaged 51.6% [drawdowns] in the prior decade"; COMP II.B "discovery cycle: pre-discovery -> catalyst (buy here)".

concentrated_segments.note: Severity of concentration risk (a warning archetype: higher = more concentrated, fewer segments, and concentration rising).
concentrated_segments.source: CODE AE "One bad year in the dominant segment sinks the whole business. FIRES as a NEGATIVE signal".

crisis_asset_backed_recovery.note: Crisis washout (depth vs 52w and 5y range) below tangible asset value, taken as returns begin to inflect.
crisis_asset_backed_recovery.source: CODE Cundill RECOVERY fund (Sibir -79% on the 1998 default with reserves intact); COMP II.E "man in a hole (fall-then-rise)".

cundill_deep_value.note: Existing cundill_score is the right measure (his six-point checklist, depth to ~2/3 NAV); corroborated by the tangible-book discount and cash yield.
cundill_deep_value.source: CODE Cundill six-point checklist ("bought near ~2/3 of NAV with a hard margin of safety"); COMP I.6 scrapyard.

customer_float.note: Customers funding the business on every working-capital lens (operating NWC, cash-conversion cycle, total NWC, deferred revenue) and the float showing up as CFO above NI.
customer_float.source: COMP I.2 Den Fujita "time-as-inventory; contracts-at-a-loss-then-monetise"; COMP I.5 Harpin subscription model.

dead_option.note: How completely the price has capitulated versus how alive the cash engine and balance sheet still are (convexity, not value).
dead_option.source: MAR I.F (12) "Option Mispriced as Dead ... balance sheet survives to catalyst, downside already emotionally capitulated. This is convexity, not value."

discounted_vehicle.note: Depth of the discount to a hard, net-cash-backed book plus evidence the discount is being closed (capital actually returned).
discounted_vehicle.source: MAR I.G (8) "Discounted Vehicle With a Catalyst to Prove NAV ... Discount + catalyst = value realisation"; failure mode "the discount is a governance trap".

diversified_segments.note: Degree of diversification (HHI, count) plus the resilience it is supposed to buy (worst-year operating margin).
diversified_segments.source: CODE AD "Real diversification of revenue streams, lowers single-segment risk". (No source-doc thesis; resilience label.)

dividend_verified_value.note: A fat payout proven by coverage (NI and FCF payout ratios, years uncovered) and by duration (raise streak - longer is better) at a sub-book price.
dividend_verified_value.source: CODE F10 "Dividends are the hardest accounting item to fake"; COMP I.4 Tillinghast "certainty (how predictable the cash flows are)".

double_inflect.note: Both accrual and cash returns crossed zero - measured by the size of the accrual turn, the cash turn and the growth underneath (event continuous-ised by magnitude).
double_inflect.source: COMP I.8 "first clean quarter ... behaviour change against a low reaction"; CODE W "confirms the inflection is real cash, not accounting-driven".

dta_reversal.note: Size of the reversible allowance vs price and how established the profitability is (margin, returns, NI growth streak - a longer profit record makes reversal likelier).
dta_reversal.source: COMP III post-reorg "NOL tax assets - quantum ... valuation allowance".

durable_reinvestment.note: Compounding engine measured several ways: incremental returns (NOPAT and cash), base ROIC, BVPS and FCF-per-share compounding over 5y, and the length of the positive-ROIC record.
durable_reinvestment.source: COMP I.1 Meyer Phelps 100x: "(2) High sustained ROE/ROIC (>15%). (3) A long reinvestment runway ... (7) capacity to compound EPS ~20%+ for a decade"; MAR II "Long holding period (median 9 years to 10x)".

exceptional_evsg.note: Exceptionally low EV/sales per unit of growth, growth confirmed on TTM and 3y bases, with a profitability level (Yartseva: level, not rate).
exceptional_evsg.source: MAR II Yartseva "it is the LEVEL of profitability and cash flow, not the GROWTH RATE"; COMP II.B growth >=25%.

expensed_growth_value.note: Cheap on gross earnings power while growth spend runs through the P&L: EV/GP, gross-to-operating gap, explicit R&D intensity, growth, self-funded.
expensed_growth_value.source: MAR VI Andreola/Deden "gross margin stable/rising, operating income positive or inflecting"; PER XMTR "marketplace gross margin rising ... operating leverage".

fastest_segment.note: Existing seg_inflect_score (share of segment lenses confirming) plus growth rate, mix shift toward the winner, acceleration and the length of its growth streak.
fastest_segment.source: MAR I.C (6) "Hidden Segment Inside a Bad Consolidated Screen ... bad consolidated optics hide a good internal vector"; PER RELL "rapidly growing green-energy segment".

financials_value.note: Book-value-cheap operating financial: ROE earned vs book multiple paid, earnings multiple, BVPS compounding and cash paid out.
financials_value.source: COMP I.4 Tillinghast "ROE >10-12% sustained"; CODE "banks/insurers ... cheap on BOOK with real returns (ROE >= 10%)".

fixed_cost_demand_shock.note: Size of the demand shock (TTM growth, acceleration) times how much of it drops through a fixed cost base (incremental EBITDA/EBIT margin, margin expansion on two P&L lines).
fixed_cost_demand_shock.source: MAR I.D (5) "Fixed-Cost Asset Meeting a Demand Shock" - "the demand is not a forecast"; COMP II.D "high operating leverage (fixed costs -> incremental revenue drops through)".

forensic_payout_confirmed.note: Hidden value being monetised for owners: size of the forensic gap, number of independent forensic tells, and the payout/shrink returning it.
forensic_payout_confirmed.source: COMP "Convergence scoring. The highest-conviction ideas score ... on three or more archetypes"; WO Archetype 4 catalyst "Share buybacks below NAV".

geographic_global.note: Breadth of the geographic footprint on two sources and how evenly revenue is spread.
geographic_global.source: CODE AF "Currency diversification + market diversification". (No source-doc thesis.)

greenblatt_magic.note: Cheap AND good, weighted equally as Greenblatt ranks them: earnings yield (EBIT/EV, cash return on EV) and return on capital (ROCE, TTM ROIC, lindy ROIC).
greenblatt_magic.source: CODE Greenblatt Magic Formula "the two legs Greenblatt ranks the universe on"; COMP II.A Greenblatt "securities that fall between the cracks".

growth_algo.note: DLO flywheel, one lens per gear: gross-profit growth, EBIT outgrowing sales, share shrink, FCF/share compounding, cheap on FCF.
growth_algo.source: CODE "$DLO: gross-profit growth (~20%) + EBIT faster (~25%) + shrinking share count (~-5%) -> FCF/share (~30%), bought cheap".

hidden_assets.note: Overcapitalised balance sheet: the reconciled forensic hidden-value ledger (associates at carrying + net cash + LIFO/DTA/FV gaps) per unit of price, NCAV cover, and the book discount (net cash alone is ~0.97 rank-correlated with the ledger, so not repeated).
hidden_assets.source: COMP I.6 "Cross-holdings carried at cost ... strategic stakes worth more than the whole market cap" (Keisei/Oriental Land).

insider_conviction.note: Revealed-preference conviction: number of distinct buyers (clusters), net buying vs market cap, bought at a value price.
insider_conviction.source: MAR III "Lakonishok & Lee (2001) ... predictive power ... coming from purchases. Cluster buys roughly double excess returns of lone buys".

institutional_accumulation.note: Existing inst_accum_score plus persistence (quarters of net buying - longer is better), above-typical ownership gain and the price divergence.
institutional_accumulation.source: COMP II.B footprint "while institutional ownership and coverage are still near zero ... discovery cycle ... institutional (rapid multiple expansion)".

kpi_threshold.note: Decisiveness of the threshold crossing: how far margins/returns moved through the line, on P&L, cash and capital-return lenses.
kpi_threshold.source: MAR I.G (20) "Operating KPI Crosses a Threshold" (KORU first positive operating margin, Brooks Macdonald first positive net flows); COMP II.B "first profitable quarter is the strongest footprint".

large_cap_quality.note: Tillinghast four elements at scale: profitability (ROIC accrual+cash), certainty/life span (worst-year op margin, worst-year interest cover), cash (through-cycle FCF margin) and growth (5y FCF per share).
large_cap_quality.source: COMP I.4 "Four Elements of Value. Profitability ... life span ... growth; and certainty (how predictable the cash flows are)".

levered_inflection.note: Levered stub with inflecting, deleveraging economics: multi-angle operating leverage, EBITDA growth, torque, cash cheapness, net debt falling.
levered_inflection.source: PER ACH "Highly leveraged home-health turnaround at very low FCF multiple" (+70%); PER warns COMM/RRGB -> deleveraging path required.

lifo_hidden_reserve.note: Size of the LIFO reserve vs price and the discount to reported and forensic-adjusted book. 7 members - spirit NaN below 5.
lifo_hidden_reserve.source: COMP I.6 Scrapyard "Assets carried at historical cost ... worth a multiple"; CODE F15.

liger_asset_backed.note: Asset-backed neglected microcap: net cash / NCAV cover of the price, book anchor, neglect and limited dilution.
liger_asset_backed.source: LC "Asset-backed optionality ... net cash or monetisable assets cover a substantial portion of market value; the operating business is near break-even ... dilution risk is limited".

liger_lagging_inflect.note: Inflection the market has not processed: acceleration and incremental margin, lagged by the price over 1y AND 2y (both horizons rewarded), under thin coverage.
liger_lagging_inflect.source: LC "ordinary financial inflection that the market has failed to process ... incremental margins above historical averages ... low expectations following a pullback".

lindy_growth.note: Durable growth rewarded for rate, acceleration AND duration/pervasiveness (share of the last 12 quarters growing, consecutive-quarter streak).
lindy_growth.source: MAR II Bessembinder "Extreme outcomes come from time, not spectacular single-year returns"; COMP I.1 "(7) capacity to compound ... for a decade".

low_sbc_quality.note: Clean, SBC-free profitability: SBC vs revenue and vs cash flow, ROCE, and no creeping share count.
low_sbc_quality.source: COMP II.B "The cardinal sin. Dilution"; MAR VI red flags "reverse splits plus repeated raises".

lynch_reward.note: Existing lynch_reward_score (coil/release/ROC setup/progress breadth) plus years of progress (5y EBIT per share, FCF years - longer better) and how little the price paid (3.5y ROC).
lynch_reward.source: CODE Lynch Fannie Mae "a business advances fundamentally for YEARS while the stock goes nowhere, then the market pays it all at once"; MAR II Bessembinder.

micro_activist_inflect.note: Cheapness (~5x EV/EBITDA target) x fortress balance sheet x size of the short-term profit inflection.
micro_activist_inflect.source: CODE Cluster H user write-up: "microcap ... short-term profit inflection ... cheap (~5x EV/EBITDA target) ... clean debt-free or net-cash balance sheet"; COMP II.B "Net cash preferred".

midcap_garp.note: Cheap-and-improving compounder: reinvestment quality, attractive E/P and EBITDA/EV, on a rising earnings stream.
midcap_garp.source: COMP I.1 "Twin engines of return = earnings growth x multiple expansion"; COMP I.4 valuation rule.

negative_ev_value.note: Paid to own the business: net cash share of price (EV/mcap = 1 - that, so not repeated), book and NCAV cover, with cash generation.
negative_ev_value.source: MAR III "net-nets / net cash"; WO Archetype 4 "Market cap roughly <= (cash + appraised asset value)".

net_cash_returner.note: Net cash actively returned: size of the cash cushion, current payout, multi-year shrink, the cash being generated, and the length of the dividend-raise record.
net_cash_returner.source: COMP II.A "Capital Return / Tender: Self-tenders, Dutch auctions ... special dividends, capital reductions"; CODE "the legitimate, rewarded form of cash exceeds EV".

nol_shell.note: Monetisable NOL vs price on a survivable balance sheet with earnings (current or buyable) to shield.
nol_shell.source: MAR III "NOL canonical example: WMIH ... ~$6.0B federal NOLs, no annual limitation, monetised via ... acquisition".

oak_asset_floor.note: How far the hard floor covers the market cap: net cash, NCAV, book and forensic hidden assets.
oak_asset_floor.source: WO Archetype 4 "Market cap roughly <= (cash + appraised asset value) ... even if growth fails, the downside is limited by the asset floor" (CVV).

oak_deep_value.note: Crushed price above a hard parachute: crash depth, discount to book, cash/NCAV share of price, still cash-generative.
oak_deep_value.source: WO Archetype 10 "Stock price crash >50% ... Price/book <0.5 ... Assets identifiable (e.g. cash >20% mcap)"; Belluscura trap -> cash generation required.

oak_deleveraging.note: Equity accretion via paydown: FCF yield, how much net debt fell (and for how long - longer is better), cash flowing out to capital providers, no dilution.
oak_deleveraging.source: WO Archetype 8 "dEquity = dAssets - dNetDebt + Buyback Accretion ... FCF yield >10% ... Net debt/EBITDA 1.5-3x but trending down ... Share count static or falling".

oak_nav_discount.note: Discount to NAV (book and tangible book), covered yield being paid, and NAV that is growing rather than eroding.
oak_nav_discount.source: WO Archetype 5 "Price/NAV <0.70x, ideally <0.50x ... tender/buyback; wind-up"; red flag "recurring cash burns by manager".

oak_order_conversion.note: Backlog converting (lagging P&L footprint): revenue acceleration and growth with margin expansion and drop-through, on real gross margin.
oak_order_conversion.source: WO table "Order-Book/Conversion (Nanocaps) ... Signed orders >20% last-year revenue; GM >30%"; Archetype 3 "ADF ... backlog up 95%".

oak_resource_leverage.note: Low-cost producer (cost-curve margin now and in the worst year), net cash, cheap, cash-yielding, bought on weakness.
oak_resource_leverage.source: WO Archetype 6 "Low cash cost relative to spot (cash cost/AISC <=60-70% of spot) ... Net debt/EBITDA modest"; Thungela "low-cost coal producer ... ~76% gain in 6 months".

overdepreciated_assets.note: Depreciation running above real asset consumption on quarterly (FMP), TTM and 5y-average lenses, priced at/below the depressed book.
overdepreciated_assets.source: COMP I.6 "Assets carried at historical cost or impaired values"; PER idea screen "high D&A-to-capex and low EV/EBITDA".

owner_earnings_power.note: Cheap on owner earnings on two sources, OE persistently above NI (5y averages), and the mechanism (capex below D&A).
owner_earnings_power.source: CODE F5 Buffett owner earnings; PER screen "high D&A-to-capex".

pension_overfunded.note: Pension surplus vs price with the operating business itself not dear. 9 members.
pension_overfunded.source: COMP I.6 "pension surpluses ... UK DB pension-surplus plays".

post_reorg.note: Verdad emergence screen continuous: EBIT/EBITDA yield (the single most powerful screen), FCF, real de-levering, freshness of emergence. 2 members - spirit NaN until >= 5.
post_reorg.source: COMP III "Valuation at emergence. Verdad: EBIT yield >20% -> +61% average two-year return ... De-levering and moat are gating".

qarp.note: Quality at a reasonable price: 60% quality (incremental/base/cash ROIC and its duration), 40% price (earnings, FCF and EBIT yields).
qarp.source: COMP I.4 Tillinghast: "Single-digit P/E for average businesses; teens for better ones; low-20s only for exceptional franchises"; Four Elements "Profitability (ROE >10-12% sustained ~10 years)".

regime_cyclical.note: Three-layer test made continuous: priced for the old cycle (low in 5y range, cheap on mid-cycle EBITDA), supply withdrawn (capex below D&A), and the new cycle showing in margins.
regime_cyclical.source: MAR I.E (9) three-layer test "(i) stock priced for old-cycle economics ... (iii) next cycle has tighter supply"; COMP II.D "falling capex/depreciation ratios ... turn often occurs during periods of maximum pessimism".

reinvest_inflect.note: Compounder finding more runway: incremental and base returns accelerating while assets and revenue growth accelerate too.
reinvest_inflect.source: COMP I.1 "(3) A long reinvestment runway"; CODE V "ROIIC accelerating from a positive base AND assets actually growing".

retained_earnings_discount.note: Retained history per unit of price (RE/mcap via RE/equity/pb, currency-neutral), book discount, and the business still earning/compounding.
retained_earnings_discount.source: CODE F7 "Buffett's dollar-retained test, priced"; COMP I.4 Tillinghast profitability "sustained ~10 years".

roic_inflect.note: Size and breadth of the turn in returns (annual ROIC acceleration, YoY ROCE change, TTM ROIC level, cash-margin turn) on a growing top line.
roic_inflect.source: COMP I.8 "a large positive change in the business (revenue acceleration, margin inflection, first profitable quarter) that the market has not yet priced"; PER "the business motor is strengthening".

self_funded_returner.note: Self-funding proven by the financing line: share of years with net outflow (longer record better), size of the current outflow, FCF yield, cheapness.
self_funded_returner.source: MAR VI Deden: rejects companies "in the business of their common stock"; COMP II.B "Dilution ... losers diluted ~61%".

special_situation.note: binary - none. A dated merger/tender/going-private event; the true continuous measure is the deal spread (offer / price - 1) and time to close, neither in the data. Nearest available proxy: freshness of the filing, days_since(evt_merger_proxy_date / evt_tender_date).
special_situation.source: COMP II.A "Merger-arb spread math + HSR/second-request calendar ... EV = (gain x P(success)) - (loss x P(break))".

spinoff_asset.note: Spin priced below its asset backing, fresher spin better. 2 members - pool with the spin family.
spinoff_asset.source: COMP II.C "(3) a hidden opportunity is revealed by the separation"; "land-banking/REIT spins".

spinoff_quality.note: High-return franchise cast off at a sane multiple, fresher spin better. 2 members - pool with the spin family.
spinoff_quality.source: COMP II.C "underlying business quality; an owner-operator with skin in the game"; anti-pattern "Sandisk +559% ... templates, not entries".

spinoff_value.note: Orphan discount on operating yield, fresher spin better (forced selling concentrated early). 3 members - rank the spin family jointly or spirit is NaN (<5).
spinoff_value.source: COMP II.C "Forced selling is the master signal ... spin subsidiaries beat the market by ~10%/yr over three years" (Cusatis, Miles & Woolridge).

strong_coverage.note: Debt burden trivially serviceable now AND through the cycle (worst-year interest cover), on net-leverage and Altman-Z lenses.
strong_coverage.source: COMP I.4 Tillinghast "Debt/EBITDA >4x in the worst year is scary"; PER "Balance-sheet and financing risk dominate valuation when they become existential".

sustainable_scaler.note: Growing revenues and earnings and not diluting: 3y sales PER SHARE, per-share FCF growth, share shrink, growth pervasiveness, self-funding and room to re-rate.
sustainable_scaler.source: MAR VI "The MCC formula: Find undiscovered companies that are growing revenues and earnings and not diluting"; COMP II.B screen "Share count flat or shrinking ... <3x sales".

tangible_value.note: Depth below tangible book, current-asset (NCAV) coverage, how much of book is tangible, and how much of the tangible book is cash (realizability).
tangible_value.source: COMP I.6 Scrapyard "Assets carried at historical cost ... worth a multiple of enterprise value"; WO Archetype 10 "Price/book or Price/cash/assets very low (<0.5)".

tax_efficient.note: Structurally low tax on real profit, seen on the book rate and the cash rate actually paid, on real returns.
tax_efficient.source: CODE AB "legitimate tax structure from no tax because no profit"; COMP III post-reorg NOL tax assets.

tax_verified_earnings.note: Cheap on earnings the tax authority audits: P/E, full cash and book tax actually paid, and FCF corroboration.
tax_verified_earnings.source: CODE F11 "You do not pay real cash taxes on fake earnings".

templeton_pessimism.note: Maximum pessimism: cheap vs own mid-cycle, price low in its 5y range / below 5y average / off the 52w high, and the street most bearish.
templeton_pessimism.source: COMP II.D "The turn often occurs during periods of maximum pessimism"; MAR II Yartseva "price near 12-month low, negative 6-month return".

tenbagger_credible.note: Credible 10x: arithmetic clearance plus the reality gates as continua (owner cash: FCF yield and cash conversion; share-count stability), and durable growth. SBC share would be ideal but is 18% covered here.
tenbagger_credible.source: COMP II.B "The cardinal sin. Dilution"; CODE Appier vs Flywire "adjusted profit is NOT owner cash".

tenbagger_path.note: Existing tenbagger_implied_return / tenbagger_score measure how far the 10x arithmetic clears; corroborated by growth durability.
tenbagger_path.source: COMP I.1 "(7) capacity to compound EPS ~20%+ for a decade"; MAR II "Median time to 10x: ~9 years".

understated_earnings.note: Cash persistently above book earnings (now, year-ago TTM, two sources, negative accruals) while priced on the understated E.
understated_earnings.source: CODE F2 "the accruals red-flag INVERTED"; LC "clean cash conversion".

weschler_levered_equity.note: High-torque equity stub on a deleveraging business: cheap on robust cash (median of FCF/CFO/earnings yields), EV/equity torque, and debt actually coming down / cash flowing out.
weschler_levered_equity.source: CODE Weschler/Valassis "traded <1x FCF ... paid down $200-305M/yr ... bought back 16% of shares -> ~52%/yr"; WO Archetype 8.

wolf_compounder.note: Sustained, accelerating grower at a low multiple: growth rate, acceleration, streak length (longer is better), margin expansion, cheapness, no dilution.
wolf_compounder.source: CODE Wolf Compounder "NCI/ZOMD/KITS-at-entry ... multi-quarter streak"; WO "Every verified winner entered <12x EV/EBITDA".

wolf_emerging.note: Cash discipline in a nascent sector (positive CFO, clean SBC) at a reasonable multiple. NOTE: 2 current members - within-core ranks need >= 5, so spirit is NaN until the core grows (or rank within the wider Wolf family).
wolf_emerging.source: WO "Simply Solventless ($HASH.V) ... blew up on accounting + cash problems" (CODE: gate hard on positive operating cash flow and clean SBC).

wolf_seal.note: Earnings inflection bought on the post-earnings dip: size of the inflection (EBIT, sales) and surprise, the dip (earnings-day reaction, 13w return), at a disciplined multiple.
wolf_seal.source: WO Archetype 7 "Seal of approval picks ... a positive surprise relative to a microcap's small size can pop the stock"; CODE "earnings inflection bought on a post-earnings dip".

wolf_trifecta.note: Double-digit growth x improving margins x operating leverage (EBIT outgrowing sales) x cheap entry multiple.
wolf_trifecta.source: WO Archetype 6 "a 6x jump in quarterly revenues yielded a 23x jump in net income forecasts ... tremendous leverage"; WO Archetype 3 "5x EV/EBITDA look cheap".

wolf_turnaround.note: Size of the crossing into the black (margin swing, incremental margin) on a still-growing top line, bought cheap.
wolf_turnaround.source: WO Archetype 9 "Zoomd SG&A cuts halved its expense ratio ... from -ve to +$4.3M net income"; screen "Low current valuation (e.g. P/E <6)"; catalyst "first improved earnings report".

wolf_value_catalyst.note: Growing, cash-generative microcap with a fortress balance sheet at a fat FCF yield.
wolf_value_catalyst.source: CODE Wolf value+catalyst "Progressive Planet: ~12% FCF yld, ~$32M cap, growing"; WO Archetype 4 "MTLC profitable ... 0.3x sales, 5x earnings".

xr_amortization_mask.note: Serial-acquirer mask: intangible base, headline-vs-owner-earnings spread, and cash yields.
xr_amortization_mask.source: CODE XR16 "Constellation/Heico class - GAAP EPS crushed by acquired-intangible amortization that has NO cash cost".

xr_asset_owner_catalyst.note: Asset below realisable value + owner + catalyst in motion: ownership, book discount, cash floor, buyback and operating turn.
xr_asset_owner_catalyst.source: MAR I.G "Discount + catalyst = value realisation"; COMP II.C Greenblatt "(2) insiders want it".

xr_audited_streak_unrerated.note: Told-and-ignored, longer the better: revenue and NI streak lengths (two sources) and the un-rerating over 1y, 2y, 5y (per-share sales vs 5y return) and multi-year EV/sales horizons.
xr_audited_streak_unrerated.source: COMP I.8 "high behaviour change score against a low reaction score"; MAR II Bessembinder "Extreme outcomes come from time".

xr_baron_compounder.note: Founder-led decade-length grower: ownership, growth pervasiveness and duration (longer is better), 5y sales-per-share growth, reinvestment through the P&L, growth-adjusted price.
xr_baron_compounder.source: COMP I.1 "(4) Founder / owner-operator alignment ... (7) compound ~20%+ for a decade ... Be a reluctant seller"; COMP II.B "intelligent fanatic owner-operators".

xr_bigbath_rebound.note: Depth of the (non-cash) bath vs mid-cycle, cheapness on the normal base, cash still flowing, and the dislocation.
xr_bigbath_rebound.source: MAR I.C (19) "Temporarily Worse Than It Looks"; PER "Low-multiple operational inflection ... current earnings are depressed; require a measurable normalisation mechanism".

xr_cannibal_below_cash.note: Buying back stock below net cash: depth below cash, buyback pace, current and 3y shrink (duration), real business attached.
xr_cannibal_below_cash.source: COMP II.A "Capital Return / Tender ... Dutch auctions"; CODE XR17 "Teledyne/2022-China-ADR class".

xr_cannibal_below_tbook.note: Buying back below tangible book: depth below book, pace, current and 3y shrink (duration), earnings.
xr_cannibal_below_tbook.source: WO Archetype 4 "Share buybacks below NAV"; COMP II.D "share-count reduction".

xr_cash_leads_book.note: Cash pulling away from book: CFO growth minus NI growth, CFO/NI level, accruals, and cheapness on E or cash.
xr_cash_leads_book.source: LC "clean cash conversion"; CODE XR48 "accruals anomaly INVERTED and proven".

xr_cash_tax_advantage.note: Cash-vs-book tax wedge (EDGAR TTM, FMP annual, FMP multi-year median - persistence) and cheapness on the understated GAAP EPS.
xr_cash_tax_advantage.source: COMP III "Fresh-start ... heavy new D&A frequently understates cash earning power"; CODE XR43 "an interest-free government loan".

xr_clean_net_net.note: Graham trifecta: NCAV cover and book discount, earnings power, and the coupon paid while waiting.
xr_clean_net_net.source: COMP II.A "net-nets / net cash"; WO Archetype 4 asset floor.

xr_compounding_deployer.note: Self-funded growth engine: incremental returns (NOPAT and cash), base ROIC, growth duration, 5y FCF-per-share compounding, ordinary multiple.
xr_compounding_deployer.source: COMP I.1 Meyer Phelps "(3) long reinvestment runway ... (5) low starting valuation".

xr_confluence.note: Existing xr_score (distinct XR families x confidence) is the measure; corroborated by forensic confluence (truly_xr_score) and forensic hidden-value rank (forensic_xr_score).
xr_confluence.source: COMP "Convergence scoring. The highest-conviction ideas score 7+/10 on three or more archetypes simultaneously".

xr_contracted_backlog.note: Contracted revenue not in the trailing line (RPO years of revenue), cheap on trailing sales, cash, converting.
xr_contracted_backlog.source: WO Archetype 3 "ADF ... backlog was up 95%, yet the stock had been cut in half"; LC "backlog or recurring usage supporting future revenue".

xr_cyclical_trough.note: Mean-reversion asset play: book discount, earnings depth vs mid-cycle, EV on normal, industry capex withdrawal, price near 5y low.
xr_cyclical_trough.source: COMP II.D Capital cycle "asset-heavy balance sheets below replacement cost ... falling capex/depreciation ratios"; MAR I.E Surviving Thing.

xr_deferred_revenue_lead.note: Forward book already collected and building faster than recognised revenue, priced on the cheap trailing tape.
xr_deferred_revenue_lead.source: WO Archetype 3 "Tier1: audited backlog, inventory, deferred revenue"; LC "backlog ... supporting future revenue".

xr_depreciation_cliff.note: Charges about to roll off: D&A vs remaining net PP&E, low replacement capex, owner-earnings yield and the headline-vs-cash spread.
xr_depreciation_cliff.source: CODE XR14 "reported earnings are a coiled spring that RELEASES mechanically as charges roll off"; PER screen "high D&A-to-capex".

xr_discops_mask.note: Continuing-ops earnings yield and the size of the discontinued drag masking it.
xr_discops_mask.source: MAR I.C Hidden Thing "valuable asset inside a bad wrapper"; WO Archetype 9 SBBC "after slicing off its worthless PureKana division".

xr_double_trough.note: Trough multiple on trough earnings: price depth (5y and 52w), cheapness on mid-cycle, earnings depth below mid-cycle, survivability.
xr_double_trough.source: COMP II.D "The turn often occurs during periods of maximum pessimism"; MAR I.E Surviving Thing.

xr_float_compounding.note: Prepaid float compounding: deferred-revenue book (EDGAR, FMP-filled), cash above NI, price on collected cash, bookings accelerating.
xr_float_compounding.source: COMP I.5 Harpin "simple subscription/repeat-purchase model"; COMP I.2 Den Fujita "time-as-inventory".

xr_floor_inflection.note: Graham-and-catalyst: floor cover (NCAV, net cash), inflection magnitude, and dislocation depth.
xr_floor_inflection.source: WO Archetype 4 "Asset-Backed Floor + Optional Growth ... any success beyond that floor multiplies returns"; LC asset-backed optionality.

xr_forced_seller.note: Seller-driven mark: size of the price collapse against business growth on two lines, with survivability.
xr_forced_seller.source: COMP II.A "buy securities being sold by non-economic holders (forced sellers, index funds, indiscriminate spin recipients)".

xr_forensic_floor_growth.note: Invisible floors (hidden-value ledger, retained earnings vs price, over-depreciated base - more floors = better) under a growing business.
xr_forensic_floor_growth.source: COMP I.6 Scrapyard; COMP preface asymmetry "Upside / downside is the organizing ratio".

xr_forensic_multiple_gap.note: Spread between headline P/E and the owner-earnings multiple (p_e x OE yield), OE yield on two sources, and OE/NI persistence.
xr_forensic_multiple_gap.source: CODE XR6 "The spread between the two numbers is the upside, paid out when the accounting catches up".

xr_gaap_profit_crossover.note: Event (first GAAP profit) made continuous by how real and large the new profit is (net and op margin, cash backing) and index/mandate eligibility (USD size).
xr_gaap_profit_crossover.source: MAR I.G (20) KPI threshold; COMP III catalyst path "OTC -> uplisting -> coverage initiation -> index inclusion -> first clean quarter"; CODE "larger names ... rank higher".

xr_gross_margin_lead.note: Gross margin inflecting ahead of SG&A absorption: size, latent gap, growth base, and how long GM has been rising (longer is better).
xr_gross_margin_lead.source: CODE XR40 "Monster-class ... GROSS margin inflects first"; PER XMTR marketplace gross margin rising.

xr_growth_capex_masked.note: Voluntary growth capex masking cash: capex/D&A, returns justifying it, growth, and cash take on the price.
xr_growth_capex_masked.source: MAR II Yartseva "aggressive [investment] BUT only when covered by EBITDA growth"; CODE XR31.

xr_harvest_distribution.note: Controlled harvest handed back: payout, capex well below D&A (quarterly and 5y), sub-book price, owner earnings yield.
xr_harvest_distribution.source: PER NRP "Low-cost mineral royalties ... protected downside" (+94%); COMP II.D capex withdrawal.

xr_hidden_segment_compounder.note: Profitable engine inside a bad wrapper: segment growth, segment margin inflection, share gain, still small (hidden), cheap whole.
xr_hidden_segment_compounder.source: MAR I.C (6) "Hidden Segment Inside a Bad Consolidated Screen ... screens filter the wrapper, not the payload".

xr_insider_capitulation.note: Insiders cluster-buying their own crash: breadth and size of buying, depth of the crash, business intact.
xr_insider_capitulation.source: MAR III "Insider buying clusters (>=3 unique insiders, code P, within ~2 weeks) ... Cluster buys roughly double excess returns"; MAR VIII "at sentiment troughs".

xr_investment_remark.note: Size of the stake step-up, how large the stake now is vs price, and whether the market has repriced the book. 11 members.
xr_investment_remark.source: CODE XR43 LanzaTech "8.3% Shougang LanzaTech stake $15m->$223m"; COMP I.6 cross-holdings.

xr_latent_bath_floor.note: Floored option on normalisation: depth of the depressed line, cheapness on the recovered base, cash still flowing, hard floor.
xr_latent_bath_floor.source: PER "Low-multiple operational inflection"; WO Archetype 4 floor + optionality.

xr_latent_inflection_floor.note: Pre-recognition improvement (returns and margin moving up, FCF breakeven close) under a hard floor.
xr_latent_inflection_floor.source: LC "The combination works best when net cash ... covers a substantial portion of market value; the operating business is near break-even".

xr_leverage_detonation.note: Breakeven crossing with high drop-through: incremental margin (EBITDA and EBIT), growth, margin swing, still priced like a loss-maker.
xr_leverage_detonation.source: MAR VI "Willdan (money-losing consultant -> operating-leverage compounder)"; PER XMTR "network effects and operating leverage" (+764%).

xr_look_through_value.note: Off-consolidated stakes vs price plus cheapness of the consolidated business. 17 members.
xr_look_through_value.source: COMP I.6 "Keisei Electric Railway (Oriental Land stake ~2x its own market cap)".

xr_lookthrough_earner.note: Associate earnings engine: share of pre-tax income, yield on price, cheap parent. 18 members.
xr_lookthrough_earner.source: COMP I.6 Keisei/Oriental Land; COMP II.A "(9) Sum-of-the-parts / holdco discount collapse".

xr_margin_mixshift.note: Mechanical margin expansion: richer segment margin vs blend, speed of mix shift, segment growth, cheap blended whole.
xr_margin_mixshift.source: PER DFIN "brand, recurring relationships and transition toward software/SaaS meant fundamentals were set to improve" (+393%).

xr_monetization_trifecta.note: Net cash x NOL vs price x the turn now. 5 members (threshold of the rank rule).
xr_monetization_trifecta.source: MAR III "WMIH ... ~$6.0B federal NOLs ... monetised via $3.8B Nationstar/Mr. Cooper acquisition".

xr_neg_ev_growth.note: Paid to own growth: net-cash cover, growth rate and its duration, profitability level, no dilution.
xr_neg_ev_growth.source: COMP II.B "Net cash preferred" + growth; MAR II "Some measure of profitability present and robust".

xr_nol_shield.note: Size of the loss bank vs price, the shield actually working (book and cash tax rates), growth into the shield, earnings yield.
xr_nol_shield.source: COMP III "NOL tax assets - quantum, s382(l)(5) survival"; COMP II.A "Post-bankruptcy orphaned equities with NOLs".

xr_oneoff_loss_mask.note: Cash-gushing franchise hidden behind a GAAP loss: operating cash margin, FCF/CFO yields, cheapness on the D&A-immune lens.
xr_oneoff_loss_mask.source: PER FREE "Troubled sweeteners obscuring valuable licence-like licorice franchise"; MAR I.C Hidden Thing.

xr_owned_realestate_value.note: Old owned property at historical cost: how written-down, how large vs price, how property-heavy, book discount.
xr_owned_realestate_value.source: COMP I.6 "property unrevalued for decades ... J D Wetherspoon (unrevalued 25+ years), Marston's (0.37x net assets)".

xr_paydown_yield.note: Transfer to capital providers per unit of equity, verified by the net-debt path (size and duration) and FCF funding it.
xr_paydown_yield.source: WO Archetype 8 "paying debt shrinks EV while equity appreciates ... Diversified Energy ... each quarterly amortization narrowed the gap".

xr_peer_margin_gap.note: Self-help turn in an under-earner: margin turn (op and gross), cheap on sales and cash. The defining gap (sector-median op margin minus own) is not a df column - see proposed lens.
xr_peer_margin_gap.source: PER "Low-multiple operational inflection ... cost reset, improved mix or new management"; CODE XR46.
proposed_lenses: expose _margin_gap_x46 (sector-median op_margin - op_margin) as df column in compute()

xr_pre_scale_margin.note: Latent operating leverage provably closing: gross-to-op gap, op-margin turn, drop-through, growth, priced on trailing gross profit.
xr_pre_scale_margin.source: PER XMTR "marketplace gross margin rising from 30.8% to 33.5% ... operating leverage" (+764%); MAR VI "revenue growth without margin improvement" is the red flag.

xr_quality_crisis.note: Proven multi-year quality (50%) marked at a crisis price (50%): FCF years, BVPS CAGR, ROIC, worst-year margin vs drawdown, 5y-range position, FCF yield, book.
xr_quality_crisis.source: PER META "ATT/TikTok/scandal fears versus extraordinary platform economics" (+310%); PER fallen-platform recipe 8/9 hit rate.

xr_reusable_assembler.note: Reuse of a built substrate: marginal above average margin, asset-light, durable growth, growth-adjusted price.
xr_reusable_assembler.source: CODE XR24 Baron Gen III "CoStar/Gartner/FactSet/MSCI/IDEXX class"; PER fallen-platform "plausible route to operating leverage".

xr_segment_justifies_whole.note: Best segment alone covers EV (x12 EBIT / EV) and how much the other segments add for free.
xr_segment_justifies_whole.source: COMP II.A "(9) Sum-of-the-parts / holdco discount collapse".

xr_stake_fv_gap.note: Disclosed fair value over carrying vs price and as a multiple of carrying. 4 members - spirit NaN below 5.
xr_stake_fv_gap.source: COMP I.6 "strategic stakes worth more than the whole market cap"; WO Archetype 5 "discount on a discount".

xr_triple_floor.note: Each independent floor as its own lens (cash, earnings, dividend, book) plus the growth that funds the wait.
xr_triple_floor.source: COMP preface "downside is structurally bounded (asset value ... valuation floor) while the upside is open".

xr_value_unlock.note: Existing value_unlock_score (fresh distinctive language x event x forensic confirmation x stage/activist) plus the size of what is being unlocked and the discount.
xr_value_unlock.source: MAR I.G "Discount + catalyst = value realisation ... asset sale, tender, buyback, liquidation ... activist pressure, spin".

xr_verified_deleveraging.note: Deleveraging path verified by balance sheets: duration (longer is better) and size of the net-debt decline, cheap EV/EBITDA, FCF funding it.
xr_verified_deleveraging.source: WO Archetype 8 "Net debt/EBITDA 1.5-3x but trending down"; PER ACH "Highly leveraged home-health turnaround at very low FCF multiple" (+70%).

xr_wc_normalization.note: Broken FCF optics, unbroken business: earnings power, earnings-vs-FCF gap, and the glut itself (inventory and receivable days up YoY, cash conversion depressed).
xr_wc_normalization.source: PER CELH "Pepsi destocking masking strong underlying sell-through" (+45%); PER SWBI "channel inventory normalisation" (+21%).
